data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I’d recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

The best choice depends on whether you prioritize ease of use, security controls, or keeping costs low.

My general recommendation\:

- **Best overall\:** 1Password — polished, easy to manage, excellent team-sharing features.
- **Best value\:** Bitwarden Teams — strong security, open-source foundations, and affordable pricing.
- **Best for growing businesses\:** A business-focused plan with centralized administration, access policies, and employee onboarding/offboarding.

## Comparison for a small business

| Password manager | Best for | Approx. monthly price |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **1Password Teams Starter Pack** | Ease of use, up to 10 users | \$24.95 total |
| **Bitwarden Teams** | Best value and security | \$4/user |
| **Keeper Business Starter** | Very small teams | \$2/user |
| **Dashlane** | Security monitoring and reporting | \$8/user |


Prices are USD, generally with annual billing; verify current terms before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.bravotech.org](https://www.bravotech.org/best-password-managers-small-teams/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[velotouch.com](https://velotouch.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My top two

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall experience)

- Excellent shared vaults.
- Easy for nontechnical employees.
- Good access controls and administration.
- Particularly good for teams that share logins across departments.

Teams Starter Pack: approximately \$24.95/month for 10 people.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Bitwarden Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/eNX1NgJ_YQkqYq1cO3Kn9HiLOHIt9rR75akT9odoUCizFVWllqu1l3xBq4C0hbJ4cFbi7HPQFtIf0o5gNHROs4hqzmiq_nZKmFh-h6jW5eeR_k_IjmjE0qqfxbKor21ZKCRUVA_kRJE4Emftm21mqKKnCcnEYqW0x0PqIVCQi6dE032C71tcSN-jx_BLKsq-?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source foundations.
- Secure shared collections.
- Good administrative controls.
- Excellent price-to-feature ratio.

Teams: approximately \$4/user/month.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

[toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-password-manager-for-teams?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I would choose

- **2–10 employees\:** 1Password Teams Starter Pack.
- **10–30 employees\:** Bitwarden Teams if keeping costs down matters.
- **Growing company with more sophisticated IT needs\:** 1Password Business or Bitwarden Enterprise.

Regardless of which you choose, make sure you\:

1. Require MFA for every employee.
2. Create separate shared vaults for departments or projects.
3. Never share one master account among employees.
4. Remove access immediately when someone leaves.
5. Keep company credentials separate from personal passwords.

## One question to narrow it down

**How many people will be using the password manager?**

That will help me recommend the best plan rather than having you pay for business features you don't need.
